Old moto_search_screen.dart:32-33 dates read from catalogFilterProvider, :35-42 and :188-196 write/clear it. v2 motorky_dates_card_v2.dart:36 reads catalogFilterProvider, :104-115 same AvailabilityCalendar with catSetDates / catClearDates (catalog_date_sheet_v2.dart:6-21, identical copyWith writes; the chunk's cited lines :136-151 do not exist, file has 21 lines).
